Albania is one of Europe’s most underrated travel destinations, and in this video, we take you on an unforgettable journey through Ksamil Beach, authentic Albanian local food, and a magical sunset in Sarandë
If you are looking for a beautiful European country without the hassle of a Schengen visa, Albania might just be the perfect destination for you. Crystal-clear turquoise water, white sandy beaches, affordable prices, friendly locals, and delicious Mediterranean food — Albania truly feels like a hidden paradise in Europe.
